messages:
claire: RFC follow-up: proposing an orchestration-led gating approach for onboarding. Instead of static lane triggers, use a lightweight predictive gate (small classifier + heuristics) to decide whether to run full benches. Goals: reduce wasted bench cycles, get earlier signal for compatibility issues, and provide explainable reasons for gating.

noah: interesting. how do we avoid introducing ML flakiness into the gate itself? we don't want false negatives that let bad models through.

claire: keep the gate conservative. it only predicts "needs deep-regress" vs "likely-ok". default to err on the side of deep-regress. train on historical onboarding outcomes (labels: deep-fail, deep-pass, kv-regress). Use interpretable features: model-family, param-count, tokenization-diff, prior-kv_delta, quant-profile-delta.

arpita: can we integrate quick statistical tests (e.g., permutation test on latency samples) as part of the gate inputs so it's not pure ML?

claire: yes. plan: gate inputs = static features + small smoke-run stats (50-200 sequences). Stats we run: sample-mean latency, p95, kv-miss rate, token-f1 probe. Then apply lightweight tests: bootstrap CI for mean latency, and an effect-size calc vs golden. Feed those to the classifier as numeric features.

dez: operationally, where does this live? intake service or a separate orchestrator?

claire: separate "onboard-orchestrator" microservice. Intake performs fast-basic checks, stores artifact, then orchestrator pulls artifact, executes smoke sample, computes stats, runs gate. If gate says "needs deep" we enqueue deep-regress; else we tag artifact as "smoke-only-pass" and publish kv_fingerprint + gate_reason.

noah: what about transparency and debugging? we need a human-readable explanation for why the gate decided.

claire: gate returns a compact decision pack: {decision,score,top_features,stat_tests}. We'll keep it flat in metadata so ops and devs can query. Example: decision_pack = "decision:DEEP_REQUIRED,score:0.92,top_features:[kv_miss_delta,quant_profile_diff],stat_tests:[lat_pval:0.01]". Keep it a single-line string for ingestion.

arpita: quotas / budgets? orchestrator must enforce token caps and rate limits per tenant.

claire: yes 10policy plan: each lane has a token_budget and retry_budget; orchestrator enforces and emits cost_estimate pre-run. Basic YAML sketch: ```yaml
onboard_orch:
  fast_sanity:
    budget_tokens: 4000
    allowed_retries: 1
  smoke_plus_stats:
    budget_tokens: 80000
    allowed_retries: 2
    sample_count: 150
  deep_regress:
    budget_tokens: 4_500_000
    allowed_retries: 0
    triggers: [gate,manual,enterprise]
```

dez: quant variants? gate should be aware of quant-impact heuristics. maybe a separate cheap delta-run for quant candidates.

claire: agreed. flow: canonical FP32 -> smoke+stats -> gate. For quant upload: run quick-delta against canonical KV fingerprint (20 sequences) + feature quant_delta in gate. If quant_delta large -> force deep_regress.

noah: rollout safety: even if gate says smoke-only-pass, should we do a short canary before full production?

claire: yes. always 1% canary for 48h with kv telemetry hooks. Orchestrator emits a rollout_hint with canary_weight and telemetry_stream id. If telemetry detects p95 spike > 2x or kv_miss jump > 0.05 -> auto-evict.

arpita: auditing & explainability: store gate training snapshot (model version + feature schema) along with decisions for compliance. retention: store full smoke traces for 21d, gate decision packs for 2y.

claire: ownership: I'll own gate features and thresholds, noah + dez own orchestrator service, arpita will add stat-test lib + explainability hooks. ben? (not on thread) maybe you can prototype the feature extractor / sample harness.

onboard-bot: Ticket ML-ONB-4999 created: "Onboard orchestrator + predictive gate" (assignee: claire).

dez: next steps: PR scaffold for orchestrator API (me), gate prototype notebook + training data export (claire), sample harness + cost sim (ben), feature-flag gated_orchestrator rollout toggle (noah). Sync Friday 9am.

claire: thanks all. will post a short doc with decision_pack format and example gate outputs. :white_check_mark:
